title: Pure Megalith
summary: Megalith cards only, with generic staples; the page's Impcantation, Drytron and Herald engines are left out. Megaliths Ritual Summon each other through their own effects, so the deck runs no Ritual Spell. The 2025 cards lead: Megalith Anastasis discards a card to search one small and one big Megalith and pays you back with a draw or a Tribute on each Ritual Summon. Megalith Notrah Plura, revealed from the hand, stops the opponent from responding to Megalith effects and negates on the field, and Megalith Phuloch recovers a card and Ritual Summons another Megalith from the GY. Megalith Phul still Ritual Summons from the Deck on the opponent's turn.
